biggest_catch: CrowdGen's official FAQ says you can view each project's pay rate before applying - but the platform publishes no concrete rates and no payout schedule on its own pages.
catches: No official concrete worker pay figures: 'you can view the pay rate for each project before applying' - amounts are per-project and undisclosed here.
Projects require unpaid qualification processes before you can begin working.
Most project work is in lower-paying markets; per-hour equivalents reported by third parties ($1–$5) are unverified here.

c1.evidence: CrowdGen's official FAQ: 'On the CrowdGen platform, you can view the pay rate for each project before applying.' No concrete figures published on official pages.

c2.evidence: No official payout schedule found in CrowdGen's official FAQ or project pages.

c3.evidence: Official: 'We will never ask you to pay anything to join our projects.'

c4.evidence: Fails both the official-pay and official-timing requirements.

eligibility: Create a free CrowdGen account; pass project qualification assessments; some projects require language exams.
maximize: CrowdGen is rejected here because its official FAQ publishes no concrete pay figures and no payout schedule. If official terms ever publish them, use its own guardrails: check each project's pay rate before applying (CrowdGen says it's visible pre-application) and track hours worked against earnings, since pay is project-dependent.
notes: CrowdGen (Appen's contributor platform) is large and free to join, but official pages give only aggregate '$157 million paid in 2022' figures - no current per-worker pay or payout schedule.
numeric_basis: backfill: Rejected - official FAQ shows no concrete rates; per-project rates undisclosed
payout_quote: No official numeric worker pay. Official FAQ: 'Most of the time, you'll be paid in US dollars.' 'On the CrowdGen platform, you can view the pay rate for each project before applying.' '$157 million' paid in 2022 is aggregate platform volume, not worker pay.
payout_value_note: Rejected - official pages publish no concrete worker pay figures

s6.note: Fails: no official concrete pay and no official payout timing.

steps: Create a free CrowdGen account on crowdgen.com.
Complete the work and withdraw via PayPal, Payoneer, Airtm, or bank transfer.
